name: Slate & Indigo
contrast_notes: Primary (#4F46E5) on background passes AA for large text and UI components; use #FFFFFF text on primary for buttons (AAA).

name: Ink & Amber
contrast_notes: Amber accent reserved for interactive/status elements only; body text uses #E6E8EC at ~13:1 contrast on background.

name: Forest & Sand
contrast_notes: Primary green on sand background exceeds AA; accent terracotta reserved for secondary emphasis, not body text.

name: Midnight & Cyan
contrast_notes: Cyan primary has strong contrast on dark backgrounds but fails as body text — use only for links/icons/accents.

name: Rose & Charcoal
contrast_notes: Rose primary on white passes AA for large text/buttons; avoid rose-on-rose combinations for body copy.

name: Neutral Gray-Blue
contrast_notes: Standard neutral-gray/blue accent system; text at 16.1:1, primary blue at 5.2:1 on white (AA for normal text).

name: Plum & Gold
contrast_notes: Deep plum primary exceeds AAA on light backgrounds; gold accent used sparingly to avoid eye fatigue.

name: Pastel Multitone
contrast_notes: Text kept dark/neutral despite the playful accents so contrast never depends on the pastel hues.

name: True Black & Neon
contrast_notes: Pure black risks OLED halation with saturated neon text — cap large neon text blocks and prefer #0D0D0D surfaces over #000000 for body content.

name: Terracotta & Cream
contrast_notes: Terracotta primary passes AA on cream; gold accent restricted to badges/highlights, never body text.

name: Arctic Blue
contrast_notes: Chosen specifically for AAA text contrast; primary blue at 8.9:1 on white for confident use as body-adjacent text.

name: Deep Teal & Coral
contrast_notes: Coral accent reserved for alerts/CTAs; teal primary and cream text both exceed AA against the dark teal ground.

name: Graphite & Lime
contrast_notes: Lime primary is bright against graphite for status/success semantics; avoid pairing lime text on lime-tinted surfaces.

name: Lavender & Ink
contrast_notes: Deep violet primary passes AA at normal text sizes; light accent lavender restricted to decorative/background use.

name: Sunset (Gradient-Safe)
contrast_notes: Orange/pink pairing designed to stay legible even when used as a gradient endpoint pair behind white UI text.

name: Navy & Gold (Finance)
contrast_notes: Navy primary exceeds AAA; gold reserved strictly for premium-tier badges, never for critical status (use semantic red/green separately).

name: Mono Grayscale + Blue Accent
contrast_notes: Grayscale ramp does the heavy lifting; blue accent used only for the ~5% of elements that are truly interactive.

name: Earthy Clay
contrast_notes: Clay primary and moss accent both pass AA on the warm neutral background; avoid low-contrast clay-on-clay text pairings.

name: Electric Violet (Dark)
contrast_notes: Violet/cyan pairing is vivid but body text stays neutral off-white to guarantee contrast independent of the accent choice.

name: Warm Grayscale (Editorial)
contrast_notes: Optimized for long reading sessions: warm off-white reduces glare versus pure white, text at 15:1 contrast.

name: Seafoam & Coral (Wellness)
contrast_notes: Seafoam primary passes AA on white surfaces; coral accent used sparingly for encouragement/CTA moments only.
